Q1: How much should this triage issue fix?
Choices:
A) Only the flaky timing regexes in `SingleFileModulesConcurrencyContractTest.test_full_body_overlaps_modules_and_fails_closed`: lines 4662 and 4669 accept `-?\d+`, matching line 4661. Leave the closed-reader failure (`test_gh_retry_stdout_isolation.py:242`) to the open PRs that already target it (#9246 / #9264 / #9267 / #9316). The workflow step and `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` stay unchanged. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Option A, plus fix the closed-reader failure in this issue too. That means making the `gh_retry` closed-pipe status report non-zero when `cat` is Rust coreutils on ubuntu-26.04, in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` and/or its test. This may conflict with the open PRs listed in A.
C) Change nothing here and close this issue as a duplicate of open PR #9246, which already covers both the heartbeat clock and the closed-reader test.
